idea-plugin.name: Ventus API Search
idea-plugin.description:
Ventus API Search is an IntelliJ IDEA plugin for searching Spring MVC / Spring Boot, JAX-RS, Feign and Spring Cloud Gateway endpoints. It supports fuzzy search by URL, method name and comments, a REST Services sidebar with module and HTTP method filters, and copy URL / cURL / JSON actions with automatic module port resolution.
Usage: 1. Press Alt+' (configurable in Keymap) to open the API search popup. Type a URL, method name or comment; use the "Only this module" checkbox and HTTP method filter to narrow results. 2. Right-click a Controller method and choose SearchApi to copy URL, full URL, cURL or JSON. 3. Open the "REST Services" tool window on the right for a browsable list with filters, cell copy and column configuration. 4. Ports are resolved from Run/Debug configuration or the module's application.yml/properties; override them in Settings > Tools > API Search.
中文说明： API Search 是一款 IntelliJ IDEA 插件，用于搜索 Spring MVC / Spring Boot、JAX-RS、Feign 与 Spring Cloud Gateway 接口。支持按 URL、方法名、注释模糊检索，右侧提供 REST Services 侧边栏（模块/HTTP 方法筛选、单元格复制、列配置），并可复制 URL、完整 URL、cURL、示例 JSON，端口按模块配置自动解析。
使用方法： 1. 按 Alt+'（可在 Keymap 修改）打开搜索弹窗，输入 URL、方法名或注释；可勾选 Only this module、选择 HTTP 方法筛选。 2. 在 Controller 方法上右键 SearchApi，复制 URL / 完整 URL / cURL / JSON。 3. 打开右侧 REST Services 侧边栏浏览、筛选、复制单元格。 4. 端口优先读取 Run/Debug 配置，其次 application.yml/properties；可在 Settings > Tools > API Search 中覆写。
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 0.1.0: 初始版本，支持 Spring MVC / JAX-RS / Feign / Gateway 接口搜索、侧边栏筛选、复制 URL / cURL / JSON。
